Since this course was newly added to the curriculum, we took this course as 3rd graders this year, but I think it is definitely a course suitable for the 2nd semester of first graders. Even giving it to second graders means it is too late. To make the course maximum efficient for the students, it is given together with the 1st grade FA102 studio.

The workload was fair enough for the course; there was a presentation and one assignment during the semester, which I found plausible. The lecture amount is also appropriate to retain as the examinations were open-book, and it became a help to us. The coherence of the lectures with one another was very good.
